title: Automated Reporting and Analytics Platform
summary: A Google Cloud pipeline that consolidates spreadsheet reports from multiple accounts into a BigQuery warehouse, with automated dashboards and AI-generated insights.
highlights: Built an automated reporting pipeline on Google Cloud that collects spreadsheet reports from multiple company accounts through the Google Sheets API, standardizes disparate formats, and consolidates them into a centralized analytics platform.
Designed a BigQuery data warehouse with Python-based ingestion, transformation, validation, and KPI aggregation to support management reporting.
Automated manager-facing dashboards and reports with Looker Studio and Google Sheets, reducing manual data consolidation and improving reporting consistency.

Added data-quality checks, anomaly detection, and Gemini-generated business insights, and deployed the workflow on Cloud Run and Cloud Scheduler for scheduled, scalable ingestion with minimal manual intervention.
imageAlt: Illustration of spreadsheets flowing through a data warehouse into an analytics dashboard

title: Resort Booking & Management Platform with 3D Virtual Tour
summary: A PERN-stack resort platform with customer and admin interfaces, an end-to-end reservation flow, and an interactive Three.js 3D tour.
highlights: Built a full-stack resort platform with separate customer and admin interfaces supporting an end-to-end reservation flow.
Developed an interactive 3D resort viewer with Three.js, letting guests explore the property before booking.
Implemented backend logic and data models with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL; built the React frontend for all three experiences (customer, admin, and 3D viewer).
Designed role-based access and workflows to separate customer booking actions from administrative management functions.
imageAlt: Illustration of a beach resort scene beside a booking calendar

title: Cryptocurrency Investment Risk Assessment System
summary: A desktop tool that ingests live crypto market data and uses ML models to generate risk scores and profitability insights.
highlights: Co-developed a cryptocurrency investment risk assessment system with a team for a university thesis, aggregating and ingesting live market data to generate risk scores and insights on potential profitability.
Designed and built the desktop GUI in PySimpleGUI, letting users view risk scores and cryptocurrency insights without touching code.
Integrated CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap APIs into the application's data pipeline, and worked with a team using TensorFlow and scikit-learn for the analysis models and data validation.
Added automated tests and audit logging, and packaged the tool as a standalone Windows executable.
